lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-intensity circular spots distributed across the mid-lateral flank. Columns show varying inter-centroid spacing, with larger spots located anteriorly and smaller, more clustered spots appearing posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than those on the lateral flank.
